areas.label: Chat: sending, streaming, rendering and answer controls

cases.use: The user types a prompt in Chat and presses Enter or Send; the answer streams into the conversation and is saved with it.

tests.covers: Submits with Enter and with the Send button in the production page; authored SSE chunks render and the saved conversation holds the answer.
Slow and fast authored streams in Chat: each appended chunk is saved while the request is still running and the final saved text equals every streamed byte.

cases.use: The user asks the loaded local model questions through DStudio (single prompts, a follow-up that needs an earlier turn, a streamed reply) and gets complete, correct answers.

tests.covers: Launches one model through the headless host and sends the frozen 100-case corpus to its /v1 chat endpoint; every answer is graded by an independent oracle.
Starts Qwen3.8-Flash-Next through the host /api/start and sends eight checked prompts (arithmetic, JSON extraction, sorting, Unicode, lookup, code reasoning) through the host /v1 proxy.

Loads DeepSeek and Laguna weights in the installed ds4-server: the same eight prompts, one of them a random code given in an earlier turn, are checked against fixed expected answers, and a real SSE stream must concatenate to the expected sum and end with [DONE].
Chat request to the host /v1 endpoint with the llama.cpp Qwen model loaded: a random 4-digit by 3-digit product must be exact.

cases.use: The user types a question in the real Chat window with a real model loaded and reads a correct rendered answer.

tests.covers: For each installed model, the real Chat UI in headless WebKit on the bundled app sends a checked question; the completed SSE and the rendered answer must be the expected integer. Routing updated November 11; not yet run in that form.

cases.use: With a thinking model the reasoning is delivered and laid out separately from the answer; with thinking off no reasoning appears.

tests.covers: Thinking on returns reasoning plus the exact product; thinking off returns an empty reasoning field and the correct sum.
Production Markdown renderer and styles: paragraphs, lists and code in a Chat reasoning block are positioned like the same Markdown in an ordinary answer.

cases.use: The user presses Copy on an answer and the exact answer text reaches the clipboard.

tests.covers: Clicks Copy on a stopped answer; a stubbed clipboard receives exactly the saved message content.

cases.use: The user presses Regenerate and only the last answer is replaced by a new one.

tests.covers: Regenerate replaces the last authored answer and the conversation still has two messages.

cases.use: The user edits an earlier message; Cancel leaves it unchanged and Save resends the edited text.

tests.covers: Edit then Cancel keeps the saved text; Edit then Save regenerates and both the saved message and the produced request carry the edited text.

cases.use: An answer with LaTeX, matrices, code fences and ASCII diagrams renders each as the right kind of block: MathML, highlighted code with Copy, or a diagram.

tests.covers: Runs the production TeX-to-MathML and Markdown renderer on authored answers: matrices, inline and display formulas, roots, code fences and text diagrams. Production fence conversion: Unicode subscripts, side-by-side matrices and legacy matrix fences become MathML while js and latex fences stay code.

cases.use: The user asks for an explanation with a diagram and the model answers with one well-formed ASCII diagram.

tests.covers: Seven diagram prompts sent to the engine with the app's explanation and math protocols; each reply must contain one fenced ASCII diagram with the required structure. The reply is not passed through the app renderer.

cases.use: The user copies a rendered table as ASCII art.

tests.covers: Runs the production table-to-ASCII function on a matrix and compares the exact bordered output; the context menu and clipboard write are not executed.

cases.use: The user picks a thinking level in the composer and the next request carries the matching reasoning fields for the selected model.

tests.covers: Production request builder for Qwen3.8-27B: off, high and max produce chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking and no reasoning_effort.
Production API client: a Qwen3.6 request sends think:true without reasoning_effort and a DeepSeek request keeps reasoning_effort xhigh.

cases.use: After an answer the message footer shows token count, decode speed and cached tokens reported by the engine.

tests.covers: An authored final usage chunk with ds4 decode speed renders the tokens, tok/s and cached figures under the answer.

cases.use: While an answer streams the user scrolls up, selects text or keeps typing in the composer; reading position, selection and draft stay put and no streamed text is lost.

tests.covers: Real mouse drags select text and code in Chat during slow and fast authored streams; the selection survives new chunks and the saved answer equals every streamed byte.
Held selection, a drag into the header and Select All during authored streams: endpoints, scroll position and screenshot pixels stay stable until a click releases the deferred text.
Production follow-scroll controller on a fake scroller: wheel-up cancels bottom follow, a selection blocks the deferred jump, and follow resumes with no input.
A Unicode draft with a keyboard selection keeps focus, value, extent and direction through four stream updates and completion.

cases.use: The user opens a new chat while an answer streams and comes back; the partial answer is still shown and can be stopped.

tests.covers: New chat mid-stream, then return through the sidebar row: the partial text is still shown and Stop keeps it.

cases.use: The user asks Chat for an image; the model's image directive starts local image generation and the result is attached to the answer.

tests.covers: Production directive parser: image directives keep Italian, Arabic and Japanese prompts and are stripped from the visible text; an edit directive keeps action, prompt and preserve list.
Real host /api/image/generate and edit in image test mode: job id and file URL returned, progress reaches complete, source and reference images stored. Pixels come from the worker fixture.
Production image pipeline shell and coordinator with simulated workers: each preset yields the expected steps, size, PNG and provenance.

cases.use: The user asks Chat for a video (or selects the video model); the engine is stopped, the video is generated and shown, and the engine is started again.

tests.covers: An authored video directive drives the production page: stop engine, generate, start engine in order, a video card with file link and caption, and the direct MiniMax H3 prompt path.
Real host /api/video/generate in video test mode with the licence accepted: model id, file URL and completed progress, and a byte-range read of the file.
Production video worker script with a fake native child: command lines per profile, progress parsing and published status.

cases.use: The user switches to another model in the middle of a conversation and continues; the next message goes to the new model with the conversation intact.

tests.covers: After an authored answer from Qwen3.8-27B the composer picker loads Qwen3.6-35B-A3B with one start request; the next request names the new model and carries both earlier turns, and the saved chat holds all four messages.

Dry run of the corpus runner: the model picker switches a host-launched fixture engine from the vision to the text model; after a reload the restored conversation continues on the text engine with its attachments listed and no pixel of its history sent.
--switch-sequence: vision, text and vision models in one host session through the picker, with the history probe on the text model. Not yet run on weights.

cases.use: An answer that contains a generated file shows it as a file artifact the user can open or preview.

tests.covers: An authored answer with a dstudio-files block shows a file tile and opens the canvas with the rendered Markdown; Download gives the exact bytes, the tile reopens it after a reload and the payload is not shown as answer text.

cases.use: The user presses Send with an empty or whitespace-only composer; nothing is sent.

tests.covers: Send and Enter with an empty, a spaces-only and a tabs-and-newlines composer issue no request and add no message; the next real send (an authored reply used only as the barrier) is the only request and turn.

cases.use: A Chat conversation grows beyond the configured context; what happens next (refusal or cache rollover) is explicit to the user and no text is dropped silently.

tests.covers: Authored HTTP 400 context refusals in ds4-server and llama-server wording are shown with Retry and announced as failed; the refused request carried every earlier message and the saved conversation keeps them unchanged.

cases.use: The user asks about a detail buried in a long prompt and the model finds it.

tests.covers: A 90-row lookup prompt must return the one requested value from the real engine.
The corpus' long-context cases must reach at least 12,000 reported prompt tokens and still pass the oracle.

cases.use: A very large Unicode prompt and an answer whose bytes arrive split at arbitrary points reach the engine and the client intact.

tests.covers: Real host /v1 relay: a 90 kB UTF-8 body sent in 137-byte fragments is forwarded intact and the SSE reply is returned byte for byte.
Production relay function on real sockets: a response header split at byte 13 and a body with NUL and binary bytes are relayed exactly (make test-v1-relay).

cases.use: The engine takes minutes before the first byte of an answer; the request is not cut off by the app.

tests.covers: The relay survives 601 simulated silent poll intervals and an expired receive timeout before any engine byte (make test-v1-relay).

cases.use: The user changes sampling or settings right after pressing Send; the request already being prepared keeps its original prompt and settings.

tests.covers: Production API client behind a barrier: prompt, temperature, model and reasoning effort are frozen before the wait and later edits do not reach the wire.

cases.use: The model starts repeating diagram rows or tokens endlessly; the output is cut and the block closed instead of growing forever.

tests.covers: Production runaway-diagram guard: eight identical rows trip the cutoff and the repair keeps at most two copies and closes the fence.
100 diagram and formula prompts to the real engine: no repeated token or line cycle, at most two bounded ASCII blocks per answer.

cases.use: An answer contains raw HTML with script or event handlers; it is shown as text or safe markup and never executed.

tests.covers: Production renderer keeps img onerror and script inside details escaped and turns only the hint markup into a native collapsible.

cases.use: With the experimental prompt lookup enabled for Chat, Agent or Cowork, the produced text is identical to normal generation and no unverified token is ever shown.

tests.covers: Production lookup core and patched generation loops against a stateful engine double: accepted tokens and session state equal the serial reference at every rewind position, in Agent, Cowork and Chat hooks.

cases.use: The engine answers a Chat request with an error; the failure is shown on the message with a readable explanation and a Retry control.

tests.covers: An authored HTTP 500 on regenerate shows the engine message and a Retry button and saves finishReason error.
A 503 engine error with UTF-8 and binary body passes through the real host relay byte for byte.
Production error formatter: a generic prefill failure is not labelled as insufficient memory, real out-of-memory text is, and cloud or connection-refused errors are left unchanged.
Through the real relay an HTTP 500 for one corpus question is kept on the persisted message as the error; only that question fails and the next one starts a new conversation and passes.

cases.use: The answer stream ends without its completion marker; the answer is marked incomplete and a Continue control is offered.

tests.covers: An authored SSE stream without [DONE] shows "Response incomplete" and a Continue button and no speed figure.

cases.use: The model reaches its output-token limit mid-answer; the Chat answer is marked as cut off, not complete.

tests.covers: An authored stream ending with finish_reason length shows "Response truncated (token limit)" and Continue, saves finishReason length with the streamed text and is not announced as completed.

cases.use: The engine process dies while a Chat answer is streaming; the partial text is kept and the failure is reported.

tests.covers: A scripted engine process behind the real host /v1 relay is killed with SIGKILL after two chunks, in close-delimited and chunked framing: the partial text is saved and shown with the incomplete or interrupted message, the host keeps answering and the next answer completes once an engine listens again.

The scripted engine drops the connection after part of an answer, as a dying engine does: the partial text and "Connection interrupted" are persisted and only that question fails. No real process dies.

cases.use: The user switches model while a request is being prepared or answered; the stale request or reply is rejected and never shown as the new model's answer.

tests.covers: Production API client: requests built for a previous selection (including A to B to A) are rejected before or after the fetch and late streamed frames are discarded.

cases.use: A malformed request reaches the engine; it is refused and the engine keeps serving the next request.

tests.covers: A malformed JSON body gets a 4xx from the real engine and the next request still answers 14 for 6+8.

cases.use: After a failed answer the user presses Retry and gets a new answer in the same place.

tests.covers: Retry after the authored HTTP 500 renders a new answer and the conversation still has two messages.

cases.use: After an incomplete answer the user presses Continue and the answer resumes from the retained text.

tests.covers: Continue after a token-limit cut and after a stream that ended without [DONE]: the request carries the retained text verbatim as the previous assistant turn followed by "Continue.", and the cut answer stays saved unchanged.
Continue after the engine process died sends the saved partial text through the real host relay once an engine listens again, and the new answer completes.

cases.use: The engine was stopped (for media generation or by the user); the next Chat message starts it again before sending.

tests.covers: With status reporting the engine stopped, the next Chat send posts /api/start before the completions request and shows the reply.

cases.use: The saved engine folder has moved; sending a Chat message repairs the selection, launches once and answers the pending question.

tests.covers: Production resolver, readiness and API client with a simulated engine: the checkout is repaired, one launch happens and each waiting request keeps its own prompt and sampling.

cases.use: A saved answer written with older diagram or matrix conventions is reopened and still renders as a diagram or formula.

tests.covers: Production normaliser tags untagged diagram fences, converts Unicode box-drawing sketches to ASCII and renders unlabelled legacy matrix fences as MathML.

areas.label: Agent: coding agent, tools, Open IDE, Plan, Skills and GSA/RSA workflows

cases.use: The user opens Agent, confirms a working folder and the Agent runtime starts there and shows its view.

tests.covers: Clicking the Agent tab admits one /api/start with a launch id; when the simulated launcher reports ready the Agent view opens and the loading overlay retires.
The built Agent binary started with an absolute and a relative --chdir: read, write and bash pwd all act in that folder with authored model frames.
Host /api/start in Agent mode with a llama.cpp Qwen model reaches ready with a resident server pid and the requested model file.

cases.use: The user asks the Agent to read and write files; the tools run in the working folder and the results come back to the model.

tests.covers: The Agent reads a CSV of random rows with real tool calls and writes total.txt equal to an independently computed total.
The built Agent binary executes authored write and read calls: exact file bytes, argument strings and call ids are preserved through the round trip.
Patched Agent source built with engine-identity doubles: a parsed Qwen write call creates report.md exactly and emits tool_call and tool_result events.

cases.use: In a second turn of the same Agent session the user asks about a file read earlier and gets the right detail.

tests.covers: Second turn in the same session: the transcript must contain the random release code from data/notes.md (asserted on the raw transcript, tool results included).

cases.use: The Agent runs a shell command in the working folder and uses its output.

tests.covers: Built Agent and Cowork binaries run a real bash tool once and its output reaches the next authored model request.
bash pwd -P executed by the built Agent returns the selected working folder.

cases.use: Tool calls appear in the conversation as an action timeline with diffs and exact commands, and the user can copy their own prompt.

tests.covers: An authored write call renders a diff and authored GSA bash calls keep their exact parameters, line count and expanded output. The copy control on a user turn hands the exact prompt to a stubbed clipboard and shows Copied.

cases.use: The user opens Open IDE and sees the working folder (tree, text files) and, during a turn, the thought bubble, the live cursor in the file being written and the terminal.

tests.covers: Production page against the real workspace handlers with a scripted agent stream: tree from disk, thought bubble, streamed write and edit with Follow, re-read from disk after the tool result and terminal output.
Real fs/list and fs/read handlers on a temporary workspace: root, files, directories, symlink metadata and UTF-8 text with its digest (make test-agent-workspace).

cases.use: After the turn the user edits a file in the IDE and saves it; the exact bytes are written with the original permissions.

tests.covers: A Unicode edit plus Save writes the exact bytes through the real /api/agent/fs/write handler.
Real fs/write handler: an admitted save replaces the exact bytes, keeps mode 0640 and returns the new digest (make test-agent-workspace).

cases.use: The user uses /new, /save, /list, /switch and /del to manage Agent sessions.

tests.covers: Production session-command queue with simulated status and transport: new, save and switch send one session command and rebind the conversation only after completion.
Built Agent binary in remote mode: a turn is saved as a session, /list shows it with its first prompt and /del removes it.
Patched native worker with session doubles: /new publishes a fresh session and clears transcript, title and images.

cases.use: The user runs /compact (or the context fills up) and the session is summarised without losing the conversation or MEMORY.MD.

tests.covers: Production compaction worker with session doubles: a successful compaction replaces the transcript once and writes the summary to MEMORY.MD.
Real Laguna weights: /compact commits a compaction and MEMORY.MD is a non-empty file; a later turn uses retained facts to write after.json.

cases.use: With Plan on the Agent first asks project-specific questions, the user answers them and a Markdown plan is shown with follow-up actions.

tests.covers: Production page with authored replies: the hidden plan contract is sent, the question form renders, answers are submitted and the plan Markdown renders with Implement, Stay and Chat controls.
Five different requests each send the plan contract with the raw request as display prompt and render the authored question form with clickable options.

cases.use: The user presses Implement plan, Stay in plan mode or Chat about this on a finished plan and the matching follow-up happens.

tests.covers: Production page with authored replies: Stay in plan mode sends nothing and plans the next request into its own file; Implement plan turns Plan off and sends the execution turn for that file; Chat about this turns Plan off and the next message is a plain turn.

cases.use: The user picks one of their skills and the next Agent turn inherits it without restarting the runtime.

tests.covers: Choosing a skill card causes no restart and the next send carries the selected-skill marker in the hidden prompt.
Real host /api/user-skills/get returns a user-authored skill body, its modes and source.

cases.use: The user writes a new skill in the Skills editor and it is saved as a local Markdown pack for later turns.

tests.covers: Production Skills editor against the real host handlers: a new skill is written byte for byte as SKILL.md under the user skills folder and selected for the next turn without a restart; editing reloads and rewrites the same pack exactly; an over-long skill is refused instead of being cut short; a fresh browser profile lists it from the machine.

cases.use: The user attaches an image in Agent; it is saved in the working folder for the image tool.

tests.covers: Real host /api/agent/attach-image writes the PNG into the workspace with identical bytes.

cases.use: The Agent's answer appears incrementally in the transcript while it is generated.

tests.covers: Samples /api/agent/poll every 100 ms during a real Agent prose turn: output must arrive in at least five increments, none larger than half.

cases.use: While the model is still generating a write call the file content is previewed live and equals what is finally saved.

tests.covers: Built Agent binary: fragmented tool arguments produce tool_call_begin, path and body deltas whose text equals the content later written to story.md.
Production argument scanner at every two-cut split: escapes, surrogate pairs, path after content and bounded body deltas (make test-remote-tool-preview-unit).
Host relay: tool delta frames with name and call id first precede the single validated batch and concatenate to it.

The tool-stream converter created by the shipped MLX patches, fed authored Qwen tool-call text whole, per character and in random splits, yields the same name and JSON arguments as the wheel's own parser.

cases.use: The user opens RSA/GSA, describes an authorised mission and runs the four GSA phases; each phase is saved and its artifacts can be opened.

tests.covers: Production workflow page with simulated host replies: setup and Play, one start and four phase saves in order, and the report artifact read back through the workspace endpoint.
Real host /api/gsa/start and /api/gsa/phase: run directory with target, scope and safety files, selection saved and the preflight prompt produced.

A running launcher with the Agent on the billed DeepSeek API (no local weights) completes selection, preflight, validation and report for two iterations; each phase JSON is accepted by /api/gsa/phase.

cases.use: The user runs RSA on a public site and gets the inventory, capture, structure and review phases with STRUCTURE.MD.

tests.covers: A /rsa prompt in the production page starts one run and saves the four authored phases, each send carrying the selected thinking level.
Real host /api/rsa/start and /api/rsa/phase: STRUCTURE.MD seeded, phase transitions, claim audit path and a passing quality gate through to complete.

cases.use: With Loop on a finished GSA or RSA run starts the next iteration from the previous run.

tests.covers: Loop on: the next iteration starts with parentRunDir after the report save, and Stop unchecks Loop.
Real host: an RSA start with a completed parent run reports iteration 2 and writes loop_context.md.

cases.use: The user reviews the external security tools, searches them and installs the missing ones.

tests.covers: Tools dialog with an authored registry: groups, enabled and not-installed counts and search filters.
Real host /api/gsa/tools registry and a dry-run /api/gsa/tools/install task that completes.

cases.use: The Agent is offered the right tools for the loaded model: the image tool only with a vision model, shell tools only in Agent.

tests.covers: Patched prompt builders compiled against the engine: ten Agent and Cowork prompts declare read, write and edit, and view_image only for vision.
The built Agent runtime's prompt still declares bash, bash_status and bash_stop.

cases.use: While the agent works the IDE is read-only with Save hidden, and a file whose path is still being streamed opens no tab until the path is complete.

tests.covers: Typing in the editor during a turn changes neither the editor nor the disk and Save is hidden. A partially streamed write path opens no tab; the final path opens one read-only tab flagged as not on disk.

cases.use: The IDE opens only UTF-8 text up to 2 MB; binary, oversized and linked files are shown without content or as read-only.

tests.covers: Real fs/read handler: binary, Latin-1 and files over 2 MiB return no content; symlinked and hard-linked files are not writable (make test-agent-workspace).

cases.use: A multi-megabyte IDE save or a very large Agent prompt is accepted intact rather than rejected by a small body limit.

tests.covers: A roughly 3 MiB JSON save body sent over a real loopback connection is saved intact (make test-agent-workspace).
A 180 kB POST to /api/agent/send is not answered 413; it reaches the handler.

cases.use: A reply longer than the context continues across automatic compactions without restarting its output budget or losing text.

tests.covers: Production generation loop with the real Laguna tokenizer and scripted inference: an 18,000-token reply at 8k context crosses compactions and renders identically to an uncompacted reference.
Real Laguna weights at 8k context: 200 generated C functions cross a compaction, then compile and run against a generated oracle.

cases.use: A model reply with more tool calls, bigger arguments or deeper JSON than allowed is refused whole instead of partly executed.

tests.covers: Host stream parser: sixteen calls accepted, the seventeenth rejected; argument, aggregate, line, token and depth limits fail the batch.

cases.use: The model repeats the same tool call again and again; the watchdog stops the loop on the fourth identical call.

tests.covers: Four identical read calls emitted by the built Agent are piped into the host watchdog probe, which trips on the fourth.
Production watchdog: three identical calls pass, the fourth trips, nested artifact calls are ignored (make test-task-graph-unit).

cases.use: While a compaction, save, power change or new session is pending the Agent refuses a new turn and a second identical request, yet status stays readable.

tests.covers: Patched worker with a blocked session API: pending operations reject a new turn while 1,000 status reads return.
A second /new while one is preparing causes exactly one preparation.

cases.use: New chat in Agent opens the empty prompt without leftover status lines from the previous session.

tests.covers: New chat posts a session new and shows the empty view without truncated status JSON or old session chatter.

cases.use: The GSA/RSA workflow stays usable in a narrow window and with odd evidence rows.

tests.covers: At 600 px there is no horizontal overflow and phases stay selectable; a findings file with null, number and string rows still renders the valid finding.

cases.use: The user selects an offensive security profile without authorisation; the run is downgraded to passive and says why.

tests.covers: Real host /api/gsa/start with red-authorized and no authorisation records the passive downgrade in safety-gate.json.
The workflow shows the effective profile Passive returned by the simulated start.

cases.use: Text that merely looks like tool markup or protocol frames, in file content or in the model's prose, is written or shown verbatim and never executed.

tests.covers: A write call whose content holds literal closing tool tags parses to one exact call at every split point.

Content with DSML look-alikes and record separators round-trips byte for byte, and frame-shaped model text causes no extra model request. Tool markup placed in ordinary content does not execute in the built Agent.

cases.use: The Agent or the IDE is asked for a path outside the working folder (.., absolute, symlink); it is refused and nothing outside is read or written.

tests.covers: Real workspace handlers: ../, absolute and normalised-escape paths get 400, symlinked outside files get 403 without leaking content (make test-agent-workspace).
A write to ../outside.md and one through a symlink return an error and leave the outside file unchanged.

cases.use: The saved working folder no longer exists; the start is refused with a clear code before any model request.

tests.covers: Real host /api/start in Agent mode with a missing workdir returns 400 workdir_missing.
The built Agent with a nonexistent --chdir exits non-zero with zero model requests and creates nothing.

cases.use: The model emits an unknown tool, bad arguments, duplicate call ids or a call that is cut off; no tool in that batch runs and the model is told.

tests.covers: Nineteen invalid batches sent to the built Agent: no file effect, no retry and a no-tool-executed status.

Host stream parser rejects duplicate call ids, index holes, array arguments, duplicate keys and NUL arguments without publishing a batch. Missing completion, length cut-off and truncated arguments end in a model error with no tool batch published.
Three unterminated or malformed Qwen calls never become executable.

cases.use: The user tries to save from the IDE while the agent works or Stop is pending; the save is refused and the file is unchanged.

tests.covers: Real fs/write handler returns 409 agent_working while the agent or session works or Stop is requested (make test-agent-workspace).
With the host reporting the agent working, Save gets 409, a toast explains and the disk is unchanged.

cases.use: The file changed on disk since it was opened; the save is refused and the user is asked which version to keep.

tests.covers: An external change makes the real host answer 409: a conflict banner appears and the disk keeps its bytes.
Stale digest, missing digest, lone surrogate, NUL, links and new-file saves are all refused with bytes unchanged (make test-agent-workspace).

cases.use: The operating system refuses a pipe or the process fork when the Agent starts; the launch fails cleanly without leaking resources.

tests.covers: Production spawn path with pipe and fork failing on demand: error reported, charter released, no child and no leaked descriptor (make test-agent-spawn).

cases.use: A prompt is sent when no Agent runtime is active; it is refused and recorded as a failed task.

tests.covers: Real host /api/agent/send without a runtime returns 409 with a task id; the task is failed and listed in diagnostics.

cases.use: Starting a new session fails or is interrupted; the previous session is kept and the user is told.

tests.covers: An authored failed reset shows "new session failed: interrupted; previous session retained".
Prefill failure, allocation failure and checkpoint save failure each keep the old session and transcript.
A rejected or error-framed new session leaves the conversation metadata unchanged.

cases.use: The loaded model cannot save on-disk sessions; save, list, switch and delete are refused instead of pretending to work.

tests.covers: With checkpoints reported unsupported the four commands return unsupported_session_checkpoint and send nothing.

cases.use: Summarising the session fails; the original transcript and MEMORY.MD stay as they were.

tests.covers: Summary failure, empty summary and rebuild failure publish nothing and leave transcript and MEMORY.MD unchanged; a failed memory export is reported honestly.

cases.use: The host rejects a GSA/RSA phase result or the turn ends without one; the step is marked incomplete and nothing further is sent.

tests.covers: A 422 phase save shows the error with zero saved steps; a turn ending in plain text sends no phase request.
Real host: non-JSON phase output returns 400 and run_state becomes incomplete; an invalid profile or an incomplete parent run is refused.

cases.use: The runtime reports a turn error; the task is failed and stays failed even though the runtime returns to waiting.

tests.covers: Host control-frame parser at every byte split: a turn error followed by the waiting marker leaves the task failed and the host ready (make test-remote-turn-error).

cases.use: The runtime emits a display event larger than the transcript limit or stops reading replies; the runtime is stopped with an explicit error.

tests.covers: Eighteen native admission cases: a tool result over 4 MiB, a blocked terminal delivery and an invalid header stop the runtime with a named error (cases in model_rpc_input_test.c).

cases.use: After the Agent edits a source file a syntax check reports an obvious error so the model repairs it in the same turn.

tests.covers: Built native Agent with authored model frames: writing a broken .js and .py file returns the node/python3 syntax report in the tool result, a valid file gets none, and the repairing edits in the same turn come back clean.

cases.use: A valid tool call fails when it runs (file to read is missing, a command exits non-zero, the text to edit is not found); the error goes back to the model and the turn continues.

tests.covers: Built native Agent with authored model frames: a read of a missing file, a command exiting 3 and an edit whose text is absent each return an error result to the model, the file stays unchanged, and the same turn continues to a later successful write.

cases.use: The Agent, Cowork or Design runtime process dies during a turn; the failure is reported, the transcript so far is kept and the mode can be started again.

tests.covers: Real host: the Agent runtime (the pi bridge) killed with SIGKILL and a Design runtime fixture that kills itself mid-turn; the turn is marked incomplete, the partial transcript and the stop reason are kept, and each mode starts again and completes a turn.

cases.use: The saved Agent folder is gone; the user picks another one and the Agent starts there with the setting repaired.

tests.covers: A 400 workdir_missing start is followed by the folder picker, a successful relaunch and a repaired saved workdir.

cases.use: After a failed New chat the user tries again and the first prompt of the new session is delivered.

tests.covers: After the authored failed reset, New chat succeeds and the first prompt reaches /api/agent/send.

cases.use: After a save conflict the user chooses their version and saves again.

tests.covers: Choosing "mine" in the conflict banner and saving writes the editor bytes.

cases.use: A write call too large to finish is dropped; the model retries with a smaller call and the file is written exactly once.

cases.use: The user exports the roadmap as PNG, PDF or JSON.

tests.covers: The export menu downloads JSON that parses with the title, a PNG with the PNG signature and a file starting with %PDF-.

cases.use: The user presses Study on a block and a Tutor room opens that already knows the block.

tests.covers: Study opens the room; the Tutor request carries the tutor system prompt and the answer shows Thinking and a collapsible hint.
On a seeded roadmap, pointing at a row reveals Study without moving it and one real click opens the room; another block's Study switches title and context.

cases.use: In a Tutor room the user attaches a file or images and asks about them.

tests.covers: A dropped text file is included in the Tutor request under attached files.
A Tutor send with two images produces a request with two image parts and a gallery of two.

cases.use: The user closes a Tutor room and reopens it later; the same lesson, draft and attachments are there.

tests.covers: Closing the Tutor persists the thread with six messages, thinking level, attachment name and reasoning.
A typed Tutor draft survives closing and reopening the room by keyboard.

cases.use: The user chooses a thinking level in Learn and generation, audit and Tutor requests use it.

tests.covers: Off and High are persisted; generation, audit and judge requests carry the selected effort with no output cap and the Tutor inherits it.

cases.use: The user reaches Study and the block menu with the keyboard.

tests.covers: Tab reaches Study then the menu; Enter opens it, arrows cycle Add and Delete and Escape returns focus.

cases.use: Learn and Tutor work with the Qwen model families using their own thinking switches and unchanged context.

tests.covers: The whole simulated Learn and Tutor flow replayed with Qwen3.8, Qwen3.6 and 27B model profiles: every request uses the selected model id and the configured context is not changed.

cases.use: The model's reasoning starts repeating itself; the request is closed and only that phase is retried, while long distinct reasoning is left alone.

tests.covers: Production repetition guard: exact cycles, relabelled and reordered paragraphs are detected at several chunk sizes; varied text and short quotes are not.
A repeating reasoning stream on the resumed stage is closed by the detector, recorded as a recovery and the run still ends verified.

cases.use: The model writes more items or longer text than a roadmap field allows; the stage is refused for retry rather than clipped.

tests.covers: Outline, stage and block limits (13 prerequisites, 7 resources, 11 key concepts, 300 hours, over 1,048,576 output characters) are refused, not clipped.

cases.use: A very large roadmap or very many sources exceed the audit budget; the work is reported incomplete and the draft is kept.

tests.covers: A 40-stage roadmap and 65 sources raise the incomplete error from the production audit planner.
Production evidence selection: at most 8 sources, 14,400 characters and 3,600 per source, literal passages, Unicode kept and pages clipped at 256,000 characters.

cases.use: An audit reply covers only some of the requested checks; the valid ones are saved and only the missing one is asked again.

tests.covers: An auditor reply omitting one of four verdicts saves three and the next request holds only the omitted id.
Three-of-four replies save three, defective siblings are re-requested alone and three failed requests end as incomplete with progress kept.

cases.use: Selecting Max thinking in Learn warns about repetitive loops; Cancel keeps the level and Confirm stores Max.

tests.covers: Picking Max shows the loop warning; Cancel keeps High and confirming stores Max.

cases.use: Learn stays usable on a narrow window: the drawer closes on selection and the roadmap does not overflow.

tests.covers: At 700 px there is no horizontal overflow and blocks sit on one rail.
At 760 px choosing Learn from the drawer closes it and updates its expanded state.

cases.use: The user scrolls up and selects text in the Tutor while a reply streams; selection and position are kept.

tests.covers: A Tutor stream arriving while the reader is scrolled up with text selected keeps selection and scroll position.
Mouse selection in the Tutor room during slow and fast streams survives updates and the saved thread equals the stream.

cases.use: A broad field produces a larger roadmap than a narrow skill.

tests.covers: With a real model the abstract-algebra request yields more stages, topics and hours than the compact Python syntax request.

cases.use: A roadmap with many stages and hundreds of blocks is generated, displayed and edited without losing responsiveness.

tests.covers: A ten-stage, 300-block roadmap is generated and audited in batches of at most four checks, then all blocks are displayed; a draft toggle during generation, a stage-map jump, marking a block complete and deleting one each finish in under five seconds and the edit is saved as unverified.

cases.use: The model returns malformed JSON, an unfinished reply or invented sources; after bounded retries the work is kept as incomplete, never accepted.

tests.covers: Malformed JSON, missing finish and length cut-offs end as incomplete after three attempts; wrong topic ids and invented resource URLs are rejected.
Verdict batches with missing checks, duplicate ids, unknown sources or invented quotes are rejected.

cases.use: The connection to the engine drops while the roadmap is generated; the error is reported and saved work is kept.

tests.covers: A "Disconnected" transport error rejects the production phase function after one call.
A transport error on an audit retry is surfaced and the three saved verdicts are retained.

cases.use: An engine error during generation is shown in the Learn workspace with a readable explanation and a resume action.

tests.covers: The engine answers one stage request with HTTP 500: the Learn workspace shows one status panel with the written share, the readable written stage, a Resume draft action and the engine message under Technical details; Resume continues with the failed stage and reaches a verified roadmap.

cases.use: Some claims cannot be verified from the read pages; the roadmap is shown as an unverified draft, editing stays off and study is still possible.

tests.covers: One unverified verdict gives a "Verification incomplete" panel, no curriculum-judge request, no enabled edit control and a Study room labelled unverified draft.
With no read sources the audit raises incomplete without a model call and all-unverified verdicts never pass.

cases.use: Neither history store can be written; Learn does not advance, Retry starts no new work and the saved draft is unchanged.

tests.covers: With native store, localStorage and IndexedDB all failing, three Retry clicks show the failure, send zero model or search requests and leave saved chats unchanged.
A throwing checkpoint save ends the audit as incomplete after one request.

cases.use: The user drags a block before its prerequisite or deletes a block others depend on; the edit is refused.

tests.covers: Dragging a block above its prerequisite changes nothing and deleting a referenced block shows "Cannot remove a prerequisite".
Production edit function rejects a block before its prerequisite, a removed prerequisite, duplicate ids and an empty stage.

cases.use: The model's reply to a learner note is invalid or tries to change agreed blocks; it is rejected.

tests.covers: Unknown or missing answers, oversized text and rewrites that rename, drop or reorder agreed blocks are rejected.

cases.use: The user attaches an unreadable image in the Tutor; it is flagged, Send is disabled and it can be removed.

tests.covers: A corrupt PNG in the Tutor room shows "Could not read" with Tutor Send disabled until removed.

cases.use: A result arrives for a run that was replaced or stopped; it is discarded and publishes nothing.

tests.covers: A stale owner aborts with zero checkpoints published.
Abort or stale ownership at a held yield during page preparation and selection raises an abort.

cases.use: The user stops generation, reloads, optionally changes the thinking level and presses Retry; written stages are reused and the roadmap completes.

tests.covers: Stop after the first saved stage shows a paused read-only draft; after reload Retry requests neither the saved stage nor the outline again and ends verified with five stages. After switching Max to High the resumed phase requests carry the High effort.
Staged generation aborted at stage 2 keeps one stage and the resume skips it; draft reuse survives setting changes but not a changed prompt or evidence.

cases.use: A draft saved by an older version is reopened; it is offered as unverified work and its recorded failure stays inspectable.

tests.covers: WebKit run only: a legacy draft plus a failed empty restart shows the transport error behind a closed disclosure and keeps the failed record after retry.
A legacy draft without a key is accepted only with identical evidence; other turns or corrupt drafts are ignored.

cases.use: The user stops during the audit, reloads and retries; finished checks are not run again.

tests.covers: Stop during a streaming audit request, reload and Retry: the completed batch is not re-run and the status ends verified.
Abort at the first checkpoint keeps four saved and resume starts after them; changed stage, source or model identity re-runs only the affected checks.

cases.use: The first outline is too shallow or the audit finds a contradicted claim; the content is regenerated or repaired and audited again before publication.

tests.covers: A shallow first outline causes a retry request labelled as phase recovery before the five stages are written. A contradicted verdict triggers repair requests and the saved verification ends verified with one repair round.

cases.use: The model's text for a new block is cut off; the request is repeated and the block completed.

tests.covers: A first expansion reply ending at the length limit is followed by a recovery request and the block is saved.

cases.use: A first generation or an update of an existing roadmap was interrupted; after reload a clear panel offers to retry and a previous roadmap is still shown and can be returned to.

tests.covers: An injected interrupted update over a previous roadmap shows the paused attempt with the old roadmap visible and "Back to the previous roadmap" dismisses it. An injected orphaned first generation shows "Generation interrupted" with a retry control after reload; the control is not pressed.

cases.use: Storage works again; Retry continues from the saved draft and the roadmap completes.

tests.covers: After storage is restored and reload, Retry reuses the saved stage and the run ends with a verified five-stage roadmap.

cases.use: The engine folder moved while Learn or Tutor needed the model; the selection is repaired and the pending question is not lost.

tests.covers: With a stale checkout fixture at least three /api/start calls happen during generation, block expansion and Tutor and the saved engine folder is repaired.

cases.use: After editing the graph the user reloads; the roadmap still shows as modified and not verified.

tests.covers: After reload the edited graph still shows the modified, not verified status.

cases.use: The desktop app relaunches into Learn with a pending prompt; it is submitted once into the cancelled conversation and not again after reload.

tests.covers: An injected native Learn launch auto-submits into the cancelled conversation; after Stop and reload there is still one roadmap chat and one user message.

cases.use: A saved answer holds the roadmap in a generic or unclosed code fence or with alternative field names; it is still recognised.

tests.covers: Production extractors recover a v2 roadmap from a closed or unclosed json fence and a block written with alias field names.

cases.use: The user is typing a new block while progress changes or the chat is reselected; the form and its text are kept.

tests.covers: After marking a block complete and typing in the add-block form, reselecting the chat keeps the same form node and values.

cases.use: With Web Search on, the user asks a question; DStudio searches, reads the best pages, extracts facts and answers with sources.

tests.covers: Real model and live web through the host: the production search pipeline classifies, picks sources, reads the repository page and extracts facts; the answer must name the expected terms.
Production Search entry point over loopback HTTP with authored classifier, picker, page and extractor replies: reads, searches and facts with their source URLs.

cases.use: The user runs Deep Research and receives a written report grounded in the collected evidence with its source cards.

tests.covers: Real model and live web: the production research pipeline runs classify, search, pick, read, extract and judge; the report must contain summary, evidence and sources.
Production Deep Research entry point with authored replies: the report equals the writer answer and passes its quality check.
Production reply lifecycle: the exact reviewed report is rendered and committed with no extra inference.

cases.use: The user switches the composer between no web, Web Search and Deep Research and the choice is remembered.

tests.covers: Choosing "Search Local browser" in the gear popover persists webMode search in the saved settings.

cases.use: The user includes a URL in the question; that page is read first and is never dropped by the planner.

tests.covers: With a URL in the question and a classifier that returns none, one explicit read happens and no search request.
Production runtime functions extract user URLs and restore one omitted by the classification.

cases.use: During research the user sees the current step even among dozens, can keep reading and selecting earlier messages, and other chats are unaffected.

tests.covers: Production page with authored discovery and model replies: one active trace row stays in view, a mouse selection of a saved answer survives progress updates and another chat receives no update. A 71-step trace renders twelve rows including the active one.

cases.use: Before delivery the report is checked against the evidence and the request and revised when a claim is unsupported.

tests.covers: Production writer and reviewer with authored replies: a draft claiming agreement is rejected, the repair citing both facts is accepted and the rejected draft is kept as an attempt.

cases.use: The decisive detail sits far down a long page; it still reaches the model.

tests.covers: Production evidence selection keeps an answer sentence at eleven offsets up to 254,000 characters and the full page text reaches the extraction request.
Production selection on link-heavy pages keeps the heading and exception within budget and facts overlapping the retained introduction.

cases.use: With a vision model active, research captures the page view and reads a chart or image from its pixels.

tests.covers: The patched browser helper built from engine sources drives isolated headless Chrome: a visual visit returns the page text and a JPEG whose decoded colours match the fixture chart.
Production extraction sends a captured page image as an image part, marks it inspected and never serialises the pixels.
Host adapter for the same-page screenshot: captured when the helper image matches the page URL (make test-web-visual-unit).

cases.use: A Learn request runs Deep Research through the browser with enough independent sources before the roadmap is written.

tests.covers: Real model and live web: every read source comes through the browser, with at least five sources, four hosts and fifteen facts per request.

cases.use: Sources are classified (docs, repository, paper, product page) and sensible follow-up pages are proposed.

tests.covers: Production classifiers label authored URLs by kind and propose README, tests, pricing or docs candidates.

cases.use: The delivered answer shows clickable citations and source cards the user can open.

tests.covers: Deep Research in the production page served by the real host with authored model replies: the delivered answer's [S1] citation and its source card open the read page in a new window, and [F1] links to an anchor inside the answer.

cases.use: The user sets page-read and candidate limits; a run reads no more pages and keeps no more candidates than configured.

tests.covers: With limits 6 pages and 7 sources, exactly the first six URLs are read and the picker prompt holds the seventh candidate but not the eighth.
Production orchestration with simulated decisions: 6 queries, 8 reads and 96 sources in Search, 24 reads and 12 actions in Deep Research, and limits snapshotted per run.

cases.use: Evidence never becomes sufficient; research stops at its read and action ceilings and delivers an answer that states the limitation.

tests.covers: With a never-sufficient judge the run stops at 24 reads and at most 12 actions, marks the judgement incomplete and puts "Research limitation" in the report.

cases.use: Extraction, writing and review take very long on slow hardware; nothing is cut off by an elapsed-time limit.

tests.covers: Production writer and reviewer on a fake clock stay active for 18 and 30 virtual minutes and then deliver the report.
Each extraction advancing the clock by two hours still ends on the action budget with facts kept.

cases.use: The user asks for an answer under a word limit; the limit is counted and enforced even if the reviewer approves a longer draft.

tests.covers: Production word-limit parser handles English and Italian ceilings and exclusive bounds; a reviewer-approved long draft still fails the length check.

cases.use: The writer produces an extremely long draft; it is bounded with the retained part kept, and long valid drafts are not cut by an output cap.

tests.covers: An unlimited stream of 90,000 characters is rejected at the retained-draft size with 60,000 kept; writer requests carry no token cap.
The real picker and writer requests from the page omit max_tokens and the writer streams.

cases.use: Pages with emoji, case-folding quirks or hundreds of thousands of characters are excerpted without breaking characters.

tests.covers: Emoji text stays well formed at tight budgets and input beyond 256,000 characters selects like its bounded prefix.
A dotted capital I that expands on case folding does not shift offsets.

cases.use: Only a few page images are captured per run and none for pages that do not need one.

tests.covers: With a budget of three over four pages the fourth read asks for no image; a not-needed page consumes no slot.
A plain-text page returns not_needed with no image and a graphic below a long spacer is captured at its offset.

cases.use: The browser helper receives a message larger than its limit; it fails cleanly instead of consuming memory.

tests.covers: A fragmented websocket message four times the result limit fails with "websocket message too large".

cases.use: A comparison across many values or very long excerpts is bounded before any model call.

tests.covers: Twenty-five values, 25,000-character excerpts or a 64,001-character audit excerpt are rejected as over the bounded input.

cases.use: The user types an empty, zero, fractional or too large limit in Settings; it is rejected and the stored value is kept.

tests.covers: Empty, 0, 1.5, 513 pages and 4097 sources fail validation and leave the stored setting unchanged.
Invalid stored values fall back to the defaults while 512 and 4096 are accepted.

cases.use: The connection drops while the answer is written; the received text is kept and stays selectable, the answer is marked incomplete and no internal scaffold is shown.

tests.covers: A destroyed writer stream shows "Research answer incomplete", keeps the exact partial bytes and shows no source-map text. The retained partial writer text is selectable by a mouse drag after the failure.
Transport error after partial output, early end of stream and output-limit endings keep the incomplete draft with the cause.

cases.use: The engine refuses the writing request; the error is shown and no placeholder answer is produced.

tests.covers: A writer HTTP 503 shows the engine message with empty content and no scaffold text.
An error before any output leaves an empty report and keeps the scaffold only as an internal draft.

cases.use: The review keeps rejecting the draft, returns malformed output or fails; the answer is delivered only as an incomplete draft.

tests.covers: Three rejected rounds, malformed reviews with unknown fact ids and a reviewer transport error all end with delivery incomplete.
An unreviewed addition or a failed quality check marks the reply incomplete with a research-review error.

cases.use: The model picks a URL that was never offered, already read or repeated; the pick is dropped.

tests.covers: Invented, duplicate and already-read picker URLs are rejected over real loopback HTTP.
Production pick normaliser rejects an already-read and an invented URL and deduplicates a repeat.

cases.use: The draft cites a fact or source id that does not exist or was not selected; the answer fails its check.

tests.covers: Citations to unknown or unselected ids make the quality check fail with the unknown citations listed.

cases.use: A page read or probe targets the computer itself or a link-local address, directly or through a redirect; it is refused.

tests.covers: Real host web-read and http-probe from the LAN address refuse twelve loopback and link-local spellings and redirects to loopback; the canary server is never contacted.

cases.use: No vision model is active or the captured image does not belong to the page; no visual fact is accepted.

tests.covers: Without native vision the request is text only and claimed visual facts are rejected; a foreign or oversized image is unavailable.
A helper image for another URL or a text-only fallback is reported unavailable (make test-web-visual-unit).

cases.use: The model changes while page evidence is extracted; the stale evidence is not published.

tests.covers: A model file change during visual extraction aborts and publishes no evidence.

cases.use: A page loads but is only a "not found" notice or navigation shell; it is treated as unusable evidence.

tests.covers: Production source classifier marks a "File not found" page as unusable and a licence page as usable.

cases.use: A selected page cannot be loaded (blocked, timed out, offline); it does not count as evidence and the run goes on or says what is missing.

tests.covers: The real host reads four loopback pages (one readable, one HTTP 403, one dropped connection, one refused port): the three failures come back as failed reads named in the visible trace, only the readable page reaches the extractor and the saved evidence, and the answer is still delivered.

cases.use: A web page contains instructions aimed at the model; extracted facts ignore them.

tests.covers: Planner side only: a page tells the model to open another address and the scripted planner obeys; the address is never requested, the host is not asked to read it and the trace names it as refused. Whether a real model's extracted facts ignore the instructions is not covered (needs a held-out real-model case).

cases.use: The computer is offline when Web Search or Deep Research starts; the user gets a clear failure rather than an invented answer.

tests.covers: The host's network path fails beyond loopback: its real /api/web-search reports that no provider could be reached, and Deep Research and Web Search both end with a visible failure saying so, without a writer or answer request to the model.

cases.use: The user stops research; in-flight requests are closed, nothing arriving later changes the chat and the trace is kept.

tests.covers: Stop research shows the cancelled notice, closes the in-flight extractor connection and a late extractor reply leaves the stored chat identical.
Abort during a blocked page read raises an abort and no further request follows.
Abort during an extractor reply or a page read publishes no facts and starts no next page.

cases.use: The user stops while the report is written or reviewed; no repair is started and late text is ignored.

tests.covers: Abort during review raises an abort after three requests with no repair launched.
Stop during an unlimited stream aborts the transport and late bytes never reach the progress callback.

cases.use: After a failed answer the user presses Retry research; a new run starts and the failed attempt stays in the conversation.

tests.covers: Retry research starts a new run with the same question while the failed message is unchanged.

cases.use: The user adds context while the research answer is pending; it is included once in a fresh answer, or kept for later if the turn was cancelled.

tests.covers: Pending context on a live turn forces new inference with the context appended once; on a cancelled turn the reviewed answer is delivered and the context kept.

cases.use: The first search engine blocks the request; discovery falls back to the next engines in order.

tests.covers: On the live web Google is attempted first and, if it failed in that run, the attempts continue with Brave, Bing and DuckDuckGo in order.

cases.use: After reading pages the browser helper leaves no extra tabs open.

tests.covers: The set of browser page targets equals the initial set after each engine and at the end.

areas.label: PDF reading, citations, image attachments and vision

cases.use: The user attaches a PDF in Chat and asks about it; when the text fits, all pages are read and sent with the question.

tests.covers: WebKit Chat on the real host page: upload, Send, one complete describe request, both pages in the prompt and the citation highlight; the engine answer is authored.
Real host /api/pdf/describe on fixture PDFs: complete text equals independent Poppler extraction page by page.

cases.use: The user clicks a PDF citation and sees the original page with the quoted words highlighted.

tests.covers: Real host evidence endpoint with Poppler plus the production evidence module in a browser: matched quotes return boxes and a rendered page, and a citation click opens the dialog with highlights.
Full app with an authored answer carrying an evidence block: an inline citation and one source control render with no raw protocol text.

cases.use: The user presses "Check passages and calculations" and the arithmetic is recomputed from the quoted numbers.

tests.covers: Production evidence module: sums, differences, products, ratios and percentages computed from literal quoted numbers, and the browser panel reports that the arithmetic agrees.

cases.use: The attachment preview offers recognised section headings and "see section" links.

tests.covers: Real describe on a seven-page PDF returns sections with level and parent and one section link to page 2.

cases.use: The user clicks a PDF tile and a preview dialog shows its cleaned title, file name and cover.

tests.covers: A saved PDF card shows a cleaned caption and size; clicking it opens the preview dialog sized within the window.

cases.use: The user adds images with the picker, by dropping them on the chat or by pasting; each becomes a ready tile.

tests.covers: Production page with fixture PNGs: three picked files become ready tiles, a synthetic drop adds one and a pasted image plus four picked files give six.

cases.use: The user opens an image in the viewer, moves between images, zooms, saves the original and copies it.

tests.covers: Viewer navigation by buttons and arrow keys, Fit and 100% and zoom, Save returning the byte-identical original and Copy handing a PNG blob to a stubbed clipboard.

cases.use: The user sends a message with images to a vision-capable model; the pixels go in the request and the images show as a gallery.

tests.covers: Sending with two images produces a request with two image parts and a two-image gallery.
Production attachment preparation for Qwen3.8-27B yields one image part with the original data URI.

cases.use: The user asks about the content of an image and the vision model answers from its pixels.

tests.covers: Qwen3.8-27B on llama.cpp only: a generated PNG sent as an image part must be answered with the colour of its left half.

The frozen corpus (28 image items, 32 PDFs) through the production page on the selected vision model; each answer is graded and the request must carry the corpus file as an image part. Not yet run on weights.
One corpus image (images/i21.png) attached in the live app and its answer graded with the corpus grader; the request must carry the file byte for byte. Not run since it was added.

cases.use: The user asks about something the attached image or document does not show; the answer says so instead of inventing a value.

tests.covers: The 60 unanswerable corpus questions are graded: an honest refusal passes, an invented value or a guess after a refusal fails. Not yet run on weights.
Through the page, an invented fee fails as no_refusal and "I cannot see it, but probably 5" fails as refused_then_guessed (scripted answers; this checks the grading path, not a model).

cases.use: Image thumbnails and the viewer work under the security policy the desktop host actually serves.

tests.covers: The page and headers captured from the real host are served to WebKit and Chromium: a local PNG decodes as a Blob thumbnail and opens at full resolution, and the image suite passes under that policy.

cases.use: The user attaches a scanned PDF; pages without text are read with local OCR and labelled as OCR.

tests.covers: Real reader and the macOS Vision helper on generated scans: scanned pages are labelled OCR with recognised lines and a citation on a scanned page matches as an OCR line.

Real reader and macOS OCR helper on the corpus scan p20 through the page: page 1 travels as an OCR block, not as text layer, and the rows count as answerable from OCR, not as pixel-path evidence (scripted answers).

cases.use: A PDF too long to send whole is read by plan: the model chooses pages or a search and only those pages are read.

tests.covers: Production attachment preparation with a counted stub planner: a fitting and a large PDF give complete, complete and interactive describes; in WebKit a planner reply for page 8 leads to a prompt holding only that page.
Production planner routing with stubbed inference: fenced JSON replies are parsed and a pages plan is returned.

cases.use: With a vision model active, selected PDF pages are also rendered and sent as images.

tests.covers: Real describe with native vision returns JPEGs for pages 1 and 2 plus the same complete text.

The five-page corpus scan p26 through the page with vision active: pages 1-4 are rendered and sent as image parts, page 5 is not, and a wrong answer about it fails as evidence_page_not_sent (scripted answers).

cases.use: In a long PDF the right pages are found by meaning with the local embedding index.

tests.covers: Real embedding model only, no answering model: semantic describe on five of the operator's own PDFs must select an expected page with the evidence text, and a repeat is served from cache.
Host chunking and term functions: page chunks with overlap at valid UTF-8 boundaries and semantic page selection including the top-scored page (make test-lan-unit).

cases.use: A vision model running with SSD expert streaming still encodes images correctly while weight spans are remapped.

tests.covers: Real vision encoder weights on Metal, no language model: after three span remaps the patched build reproduces the exact encoder embedding and routing.

cases.use: In Cowork an attached image or PDF is saved in the folder and offered to the right reading tool.

tests.covers: Production preparation in Cowork mode keeps the workspace path, names view_image and calls PDF preparation with native vision and the folder.
A PDF attached in Cowork is posted to the workspace and the send asks for read_pdf.

cases.use: With the video model selected the attached image becomes the first frame of the clip.

tests.covers: A PNG attached with the video model selected is carried as a data URI in the generate request.

cases.use: The user adds more than six files, an oversized file or an unsupported type; only six valid attachments are kept.

tests.covers: Seven files give six tiles; a file one byte over 16 MiB and an .exe add none and a freed slot refills to six.

cases.use: A message with six images shows four frames plus a counter and the viewer reaches all six.

tests.covers: Six sent images show four frames and +2, and the viewer runs from 4 of 6 to 6 of 6 with Next disabled at the end.

cases.use: The user removes an image, opens a new chat or closes the room while a file is still being read; the late read publishes nothing.

tests.covers: A delayed read after Remove, after New chat and after closing the Tutor room never republishes the attachment.

cases.use: The user adds another file while a send is waiting on a PDF read; it stays for the next send.

tests.covers: With a send blocked on the PDF read, a later file stays attached and the request holds the two images plus the PDF text.

cases.use: An oversized, image-only or sparse PDF is not sent whole; a read plan is required and only requested pages are returned.

tests.covers: Oversize, image-only, sparse and visual PDFs return readPlanRequired with no text and a pages request returns only that page.

cases.use: The answer uses the same citation label for several passages; a chooser lists them instead of guessing.

tests.covers: A repeated label opens a "Source passage" chooser with five options and the chosen passage requests the exact quote and page.
After reload, clicking the citation opens a source-passage chooser with three options.

cases.use: Quotes on rotated, cropped or offset pages and in table cells are still located and highlighted in place.

tests.covers: Entity, whitespace-normalised and cross-line quotes match; rotated, cropped and offset-origin pages and a table cell return in-bounds boxes shown in the viewer.

cases.use: One read recognises only a limited number of new scanned pages, says what remains, and reuses pages already recognised.

tests.covers: With one page per read the first read leaves one pending with a notice and the second completes; a later read of a recognised page starts no helper.

cases.use: The cache of original PDFs for source checking stays within 32 documents and 2 GiB.

tests.covers: Cache eviction on the real host keeps at most 32 source files and 2 GiB.

cases.use: Planning how to read a long PDF takes hours on slow hardware; it is not cut off and Stop stays available.

tests.covers: Production planner stays pending through four virtual hours without aborting and then returns the plan.
In WebKit with the clock advanced four hours Stop is still visible and the late planner reply is honoured.

cases.use: The image viewer, the source panel and the page viewer fit a phone-sized window in both themes and work with the keyboard.

tests.covers: The collapsed source panel at 1100 and 390 px in both themes has no overflow, Enter expands it and the 390 px dialog zooms to 200% with highlights kept.
At 390 by 740 the viewer fits the window and Close is visible.

cases.use: The user attaches an encrypted or password-protected PDF; the app says it cannot be read.

tests.covers: A PDF generated at run time with a user password: every describe profile, the text format and the preview of the real host answer 422 encrypted with a password-protected message and no text; an owner-password-only PDF is still read.
Attaching that PDF in the production page served by the real host marks its tile not read with the reason, shows a toast, blocks Send without any model request, and removing it restores Send.

cases.use: The user attaches a PDF with hundreds or thousands of pages; reading stays bounded and responsive.

tests.covers: A 2,500-page PDF generated at run time: the complete probe asks for a read plan, the overview stays within its character budget and page sample, a late page is read exactly, pages past the 2,000-page ceiling or the end are refused with the document size, and a held read does not delay status or another PDF read.
Attaching the 2,500-page PDF in the production page sends one planner request and an answer request carrying a bounded excerpt labelled with the sampled share of the 2,500 pages.

cases.use: The user attaches a corrupt image; the tile shows the failure, Send is disabled and removing it restores Send.

tests.covers: A corrupt PNG gives a failed tile with Send disabled until it is removed.

cases.use: The user attaches an image while a text-only model is selected; sending is blocked with an explanation and the attachment is kept.

tests.covers: With a text-only model saved, Send is disabled and "Choose vision model" opens the model menu with the tile kept.
On a text-only model an attached image disables Send with "This model cannot read images" and no request is made.
Production preparation returns nothing for Laguna, DeepSeek Flash, Qwen3.6, Qwen Next and the 27B MLX folder, keeping the attachment and showing a notice.
With a text-only model the page refuses every corpus image question with the file kept and sends nothing; the runner removes the kept file before the next item, and PDFs travel as text only.

--expect text-only on a real text model: images refused by the app with the file kept, any visual payload in any request fails the row, pixel-only facts graded as honest limitations. Not yet run on weights.

cases.use: The encoder file is installed but the running engine has no vision; the answer explains that instead of sending or offering a download.

tests.covers: With status reporting vision inactive, the reply says the encoder is installed and no completion request is sent.

cases.use: The model's matching vision encoder or projector is missing or belongs to another checkpoint; vision is reported unavailable or the pair is refused.

tests.covers: The real ds4 binary built with the production patches inspects sparse files carrying published headers: each V4.1 Q2 opens only with its own sidecar and mixed pairs are refused. No weights are loaded.
Production capability functions: an old V4 encoder does not satisfy V4.1 and the matching download is still offered.
Real start handler: a 27B Agent launch without its projector is refused with model_component_missing (make test-launch-preflight).

cases.use: A cited quotation cannot be located or occurs several times; no misleading highlight is selected and the reason is shown.

tests.covers: Altered text is not_found, a repeated phrase is ambiguous with "Passage appears more than once" and an image-only page reports no text layer.

cases.use: The model's source details are malformed or truncated; they are hidden with a warning and never shown as verified.

tests.covers: Invalid, truncated and oversized evidence blocks yield no evidence, keep the prose and show "Some PDF source details could not be read".

cases.use: A calculation refers to a missing or ambiguous passage; it is reported as not verified.

tests.covers: A calculation using a duplicate-id citation shows "Calculation not verified" and never "Arithmetic agrees".

cases.use: A citation points to a document that is not attached to this conversation; it is refused without a request.

tests.covers: A passage from an unattached document id shows "This source is not attached to this conversation" and sends nothing.

cases.use: A malformed page or quote request reaches the host; it is rejected with a precise status.

tests.covers: Out-of-range page 422, bad id, fractional page, over-long quote, NUL and duplicate keys 400, missing request header 403.

cases.use: OCR is not available; scanned pages are reported as unread and no text is invented.

tests.covers: With the helper missing the read reports OCR unavailable, two scanned pages and no invented text.

Host without the OCR helper: the corpus scan p20 sends no OCR text; to a text-only model only an honest limitation passes and a stated value fails as pixel_fact_stated_without_pixels (scripted answers).

cases.use: The model returns an unusable read plan or errors; the PDF is not silently replaced by an overview and the original stays attached.

tests.covers: Broken JSON, pages mode without pages and unknown modes are rejected; on a planner error one describe is sent, the bytes are kept and content stays empty.

cases.use: Content tries to run a script from a Blob URL or embed a foreign frame; the desktop policy blocks it while images still load.

tests.covers: Under the captured host policy a blob script is blocked and not executed and a foreign-origin frame is blocked.

cases.use: After the vision runtime becomes active the user retries and the original image is sent.

tests.covers: Retry with vision active again sends one request with the exact original image data URI.

cases.use: The user stops while the PDF is being read or planned; nothing is sent, the attachment and draft stay and the next Send works.

tests.covers: Stop during a blocked PDF read dispatches nothing and keeps attachment and draft; the second Send dispatches once with the PDF text.
In WebKit, Stop with the planner held produces no answer or read from the late reply and leaves the attachment, text and Send enabled.
Abort after four virtual hours aborts the transport; a late describe reply after abort is rejected and not published.

cases.use: The cached original was changed, tampered with or evicted; source checking refuses it and works again after the PDF is described again.

tests.covers: A deleted or tampered retained source answers 410 and a new describe restores matching; a changed PDF gets a new document id.
A repeat read is served from cache and a modified PDF gets a new id with only the new text.

cases.use: The user picks another page while the previous one is loading; the late reply cannot replace the current page.

tests.covers: A delayed old evidence reply does not replace the newly selected page image and highlights.

cases.use: The user reloads; image galleries come back as labelled previews and PDF citations render again.

tests.covers: After reload the gallery is restored, the viewer is labelled Preview and Save gives a preview JPEG.
After reload the citation and source control re-render with no raw protocol text.

cases.use: The PDF reader goes away while OCR is running; the OCR helper stops instead of continuing in the background.

tests.covers: The helper on a 30-page scan stops within six seconds after its starter exits, also when the parent exited before it started.

cases.use: The first read reply lacks completeness information; the original bytes are kept and the planner route is used.

tests.covers: A describe reply without completeness fields keeps the original bytes, routes through the planner and reads page 8.

areas.label: Models: download, verification, selection, loading and switching

cases.use: The user opens the composer model picker, searches by name or quantization and selects a model; it is launched and shown as loaded.

tests.covers: Production picker with an authored catalog: search by name and quantization, keyboard navigation, the Loaded region, and selecting Qwen3.6 or 27B posts exactly one /api/start with that file and the engine-appropriate options.

cases.use: The user loads another model from Settings, Models; it starts with the options that model supports and the saved preferences of other models are kept.

tests.covers: Loading Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, DeepSeek Flash and Qwen3.6 from their cards posts the right file and SSD and power options while the saved DeepSeek preferences stay.

cases.use: A selected model is really loaded by its engine and reported ready with the right identity.

tests.covers: The host starts the bundled llama.cpp server with real Qwen weights: ready, resident pid, model file, and the engine's own /props build, alias and vision modality.
Pinned weights are hashed and verified, then /api/start reaches ready with the requested model file and the requested SSD-streaming mode effective.
ds4-server loads the real GGUF on Metal and lists it in /v1/models within the load limit.

cases.use: On launch the startup screen shows loading phases, context, memory plan and prefill, then opens DStudio when the engine is ready.
